summary: New table reply_send_claims: one atomic send claim per reply, shared by the Communications and Draft Queue send paths, so a simultaneous or repeated Send can never produce two replies. Service role only (RLS on, no policies, anon/authenticated revoked). Changes no existing row.

preflight.name: reply_send_claims does not exist yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'reply_send_claims'

preflight.name: the referenced tables exist (email_messages, outbound_email_drafts)
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name IN ('email_messages', 'outbound_email_drafts')

expected_changes: New table reply_send_claims (reply_key PK with format CHECK, inbound_email_id FK email_messages RESTRICT, outbound_draft_id FK outbound_email_drafts RESTRICT, send_path CHECK communications|draft_queue, status CHECK sending|sent|failed, claim token, approved package sha256, audit columns).
Row level security on with no policies; anon and authenticated have no privileges; service_role has SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE (no DELETE: claims are an audit trail).

verify.name: the table exists and is empty
row level security is on with no policies
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND c.relname = 'reply_send_claims' AND c.relrowsecurity AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_policies p WHERE p.schemaname = 'public' AND p.tablename = 'reply_send_claims')

verify.name: anon and authenticated hold no privilege
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.role_table_grants WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'reply_send_claims' AND grantee IN ('anon', 'authenticated')

verify.name: the server role can select, insert and update (and not delete)
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.role_table_grants WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'reply_send_claims' AND grantee = 'service_role' AND privilege_type IN ('SELECT', 'INSERT', 'UPDATE')

verify.name: the reply key is the primary key
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid = 'public.reply_send_claims'::regclass AND contype = 'p'
